$comment: HomeIQ MCP tool contract (TAP-5292). Machine-readable source of truth; docs/mcp/homeiq-mcp-tool-catalogue.md is the human view. TAP-5297 contract tests pin this file against the running server's list_tools output. v1.2.0 (2026-08-17, TAP-5293/5295): tools 14/15 carry status=deferred (energy-correlator has no live output; see TAP-5910/TAP-5301); every list-returning output declares optional `truncated` + `hint` so the server can honour design rule 2 under additionalProperties=false. v1.2.1 (2026-08-18, verifier round on TAP-5293..5297): id inputs that reach an upstream URL path carry a strict pattern; detect_anomalies drops the never-honoured `hours`; search_events `hours` max is 72 (data-api's search times out beyond that today); downsample_minutes is first-observed-per-bucket; error code set drops the unused truncated_upstream; notes on the power/top_consumers pipelines being empty until TAP-5301.

tools.name: get_entity_history
tools.description: Entity state history over a bounded window, optionally downsampled to the first observed point per N-minute bucket. Time precedence: start_time/end_time (both required together) override hours; with neither pair member present, hours applies.

entity_id.description: HA entity id, e.g. sensor.total_power (id charset: letters, digits, . _ : @ -)

hours.description: Lookback window; ignored when start_time and end_time are both set

downsample_minutes.description: 0 = raw rows (capped at limit); N = first observed point per N-minute bucket

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Text search over stored Home Assistant events by entity id and event type.

query.description: Substring matched against entity ids and event types (case-insensitive)

hours.description: Trailing window to search; data-api's search cannot serve windows longer than ~72h today (times out), so the bound is honest, not the store's retention.

old_state.description: PROJECTED: upstream stores a state dict; the server extracts its 'state' key

new_state.description: PROJECTED: upstream stores a state dict; the server extracts its 'state' key

hint.description: Present only when truncated=true: names the input parameter to narrow (e.g. 'hours', 'limit').

offset.description: Pagination offset into the filtered result set

old_state.description: PROJECTED: upstream stores a state dict; the server extracts its 'state' key

new_state.description: PROJECTED: upstream stores a state dict; the server extracts its 'state' key

hint.description: Present only when truncated=true: names the input parameter to narrow (e.g. 'hours', 'limit').

tools.name: get_entity_state
tools.description: Last OBSERVED state of one entity from the event store, with its timestamp. HomeIQ observes HA; this is the most recent recorded state change within the hours window (default 24), not a live HA read — check 't' for staleness.

entity_id.description: HA entity id, e.g. light.office_go (id charset: letters, digits, . _ : @ -)

hours.description: How far back to look for the newest event

state.description: PROJECTED from the newest stored event's state dict ('state' key); null when no event for this entity exists within the hours window

NOTE: top_consumers comes from the energy-correlator measurement (event_energy_correlation) which has never been written (TAP-5910); it is [] until TAP-5301. current_power_w/daily_kwh are data-api's smart_meter figures and read 0.0 when that measurement is empty.

tools.name: detect_anomalies
tools.description: Anomaly surface: power anomalies and ML-predicted device failure risk. NOTE: kind=power reads data-api /api/devices/power-anomalies, whose actual-power source is the energy-correlator pipeline that has never written a row (TAP-5910); power_anomalies is empty until TAP-5301 provides a live source. kind=failure_risk needs device-intelligence's device inventory populated.

kind.description: power = live power anomalies; failure_risk = ML failure predictions; all = both

limit.description: Applies PER ARRAY (up to limit power anomalies AND limit failure predictions)
